verdict.rationale: Marketing-page claims describe in-product AI that works from the customer's data. A campaign agent plans campaigns from brand, audience, and past performance, and an answer-engine visibility feature gives 'clear next steps to improve it.' These are suggestion-style outputs, but they rest only on brief product-page lines with no detailed documentation of AI-generated insights on the user's own performance or CRM data. missing for 10: in-depth docs on AI insight/suggestion features (e.g., AI analysis of reports or dashboards), explicit description of how suggestions are generated from account data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Start from a goal and let campaign agent plan your entire campaign based on brand, audience, and past performance.
See how your brand shows up in answer engines, and get clear next steps to improve it.
Find high-potential prospects within your contact lists.
